_note: TAP's call-back cards (CoreMedia Engagement Cloud / BySide's widget, parity.md row 66) as www.flytap.com renders them: the page's data holds the widget's type only (ComponentCoreMediaModel), so the cards come from the capture tap-byside-001 (built by tap-click-to-call.mjs from its click-to-call.json). cards: <CoreMedia type> -> <version (pt-pt, en-pt, es-es, fr-fr, de-de, it-it, pl-pl, pt-br; a language key is the fallback)> -> { title, text, schedule, smallPrint (BySide's HTML), hours, button, buttonOutside, phone, days, slots, image (the wide picture's URL on bysa1.byside.com), mobileImage (the phone one's), alt, floating ([text, subText]), pages (the pages www shows it on), noCard (pages www served none on) }, or { noCard } for a version www serves no card for. The pictures' local copies: the capture's byside directory as a --media of the import. tap-import.mjs and tap-markets.mjs write ema-test's click-to-call block on the card's pages, nothing on its noCard pages, else the link to www.
